facts.text: The hotel is in Warsaw's city center on the Royal Route, next to the Presidential Palace.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel in Warsaw, Poland is in the city center, situated on the celebrated Royal Route, next to the Presidential Palace

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Old Town, the Royal Castle, the National Museum, the National Theater and the Opera House.
facts.excerpt: it is also within walking distance of Warsaw's most renowned sights, such as the Old Town, the Royal Castle, the National Museum, the National Theater, and the Opera House

facts.text: Hotel Bristol first welcomed guests in 1901.
facts.excerpt: In November 1901, the first guest crossed the threshold of the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel was co-founded by pianist, composer and statesman Ignacy Jan Paderewski.
facts.excerpt: Ignacy Jan Paderewski — world-renowned pianist, composer, statesman, and co-founder of the hotel

facts.text: The building was designed by Władysław Marconi, with Art Nouveau interiors by Otto Wagner Jr.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Władysław Marconi, with Art Nouveau interiors by Otto Wagner Jr.

facts.text: In 1965 Hotel Bristol was entered into the register of historic monuments.
facts.excerpt: In 1965, Hotel Bristol was entered into the register of historic monuments.

facts.text: Hotel Bristol was the only hotel in the capital to survive the occupation and the Warsaw Uprising.
facts.excerpt: Bristol endured the occupation and the Warsaw Uprising as the only hotel in the capital to survive.

facts.text: In 1919 Paderewski's political office as Prime Minister was established in what is now the Paderewski Suite.
facts.excerpt: Here, in what is now the Paderewski Suite, his political office was established.

facts.text: The hotel has welcomed nearly all Polish Nobel Prize winners.
facts.excerpt: Over the decades, the hotel welcomed nearly all Polish Nobel Prize winners

facts.text: The Paderewski Suite has original antiques from the early 20th century.
facts.excerpt: The Paderewski Suite is the jewel in Hotel Bristol’s crown, boasting original antiques from the early 20th century

facts.text: The Paderewski Suite has a balcony overlooking the Royal Route.
facts.excerpt: the balcony offering unforgettable view to the most fashionable street...See More in Warsaw – the Royal Route

facts.text: Rooms have mahogany-framed windows with views that include the Royal Route, city parks, the Presidential Palace and the hotel courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Mahogany-framed windows open to reveal captivating views, including the Royal Route, city parks, the Presidential Palace, and the hotel courtyard

facts.text: Bathrooms are gray marble.
facts.excerpt: Unparalleled relaxation comes courtesy of the soothing gray marble bathrooms

facts.text: Family Rooms have a king-size bedroom plus an additional room with a pullout sofa.
facts.excerpt: Each room includes a bedroom with a king-size bed and an additional room featuring a pullout sofa

facts.text: Bristol Spa has a heated indoor swimming pool, gym, sauna, steam bath and treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: our urban sanctuary, with its heated, indoor swimming pool, gym, sauna, steam bath, and treatment rooms

facts.text: Bristol Spa treatments use products from the British brand AMRA.
facts.excerpt: featuring the luxurious products of the British brand AMRA

facts.text: Café Bristol has original Viennese-style interiors and patisseries, and has operated since 1901.
facts.excerpt: Since 1901, Café Bristol has enchanted guests with original Viennese-style interiors, delectable patisseries

facts.text: The seasonal champagne bar sits on a rooftop terrace overlooking the Royal Route.
facts.excerpt: Our Warsaw hotel's seasonal champagne bar, located on a stunning terrace overlooking the prestigious Royal Route

facts.text: Lane's Gin Bar serves Nikkei cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy trendy Nikkei cuisine for a unique dining experience.

facts.text: The hotel's concierges wear the Les Clefs d'Or insignia.
facts.excerpt: proudly wearing the prestigious "Les Clefs d'Or" insignia of the celebrated international concierge society

facts.text: Every day at 11:00 guests can join a guided tour of the hotel led by the Concierge Team.
facts.excerpt: Every day at 11:00, our esteemed Guests are invited to join an exclusive guided tour of the hotel, led by our Concierge Team

facts.text: The Bristol Genealogist service offers consultancy for guests exploring their Polish ancestry.
facts.excerpt: we are proud to offer the unique Bristol Genealogist service, designed to provide professional consultancy for our guests seeking to explore their Polish ancestry

facts.text: The hotel welcomes pets.
facts.excerpt: Our 5-star hotel in Warsaw is pet-friendly and welcomes trained pets.

facts.text: The hotel has limited parking spaces.
facts.excerpt: We have limited parking spaces.

facts.text: Hotel Bristol joined The Luxury Collection in 2013.
facts.excerpt: In 2013, Hotel Bristol joined The Luxury Collection

facts.text: The lobby ceiling is inspired by floral Art Nouveau abstraction.
facts.excerpt: The iconic lobby ceiling, inspired by floral Art Nouveau abstraction, remains one of the hotel’s most recognizable symbols

facts.text: Café Bristol is known for Tort Bristol, a cake of Polish plums, hazelnut cream, sponge and chocolate.
facts.excerpt: The cake features layers of Polish plums, hazelnut cream with a delicate crunch, light sponge cake, and a smooth chocolate finish
